criteria.any_part: elevation + apparent radius > horizon (upper limb visible)

modes.dte: direct to Earth from a 2.5 m rover antenna
modes.dte+mast: direct, or line of sight to a 10.0 m mast at BASE within 10.0 km while the mast sees Earth (same criterion)

windows_encoding: [s0, l0, g1, l1, ...] epoch indices: start0 = s0, end0 = start0 + l0 (exclusive), start1 = end0 + g1, ...

near_dem.note: the PGDA LOLA tile the pack was built from

far_dem.product: PGDA product 90 (Barker et al. 2023, PSJ 4:183), LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ

provenance.routes: lunarsim.rover.expert.plan(terrain, a, b, sun_az_deg=None) per leg of lunarsim.rover.tables.legs_from_sites; samples every 100 m snapped to 20 m post centres

avgvisib_check.criterion: any part of the disc, surface level
avgvisib_check.epochs: ours 2028-2031 at 10 min; the map averages its own period (label START/STOP 2009-2013)

provenance.outside_80S: terrain beyond the 80 deg S DEM edge (303 km from the pole) is not included
